response.sql: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.product_price) AS mean_price, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number) SELECT AVG(mean_price) AS avg_of_invoice_mean_prices, AVG(item_count) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice FROM invoice_stats;

assumptions.assumption: "Invoices" means every row in Invoices, and an invoice's line items are the rows in Invoice_Line_Items with that invoice_number, so Order_Items is not used.
AVG ignores NULL product_price values. An invoice whose line items all have NULL prices, or that has no line items, gets a NULL mean and is dropped from the outer average, as the request specifies.

Each row in Invoice_Line_Items is one line item. COUNT(order_item_id) is used because order_item_id is NOT NULL, and an invoice with no line items gets a count of 0 from the LEFT JOIN, so it counts as zero.
product_price is used as stored, with no VAT or derived-cost adjustment, and the result is returned unrounded.
